entries.title: Psalms 136:1
segments: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:2
segments: Oh give thanks unto the God of gods; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:3
segments: Oh give thanks unto the Lord of lords; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:4
segments: To him who alone doeth great wonders; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:5
segments: To him that by understanding made the heavens; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:6
segments: To him that spread forth the earth above the waters; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:7
segments: To him that made great lights; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:8
segments: The sun to rule by day; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:9
segments: The moon and stars to rule by night; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:10
segments: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:11
segments: And brought out Israel from among them; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:12
segments: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:13
segments: To him that divided the Red Sea in sunder; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:14
segments: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:15
segments: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:16
segments: To him that led his people through the wilderness; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:17
segments: To him that smote great kings; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:18
segments: And slew famous kings; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:19
segments: Sihon king of the Amorites; For his lovingkindness [endureth] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:20
segments: And Og king of Bashan; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:21
segments: And gave their land for a heritage; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:22
segments: Even a heritage unto Israel his servant; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:23
segments: Who remembered us in our low estate; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:24
segments: And hath delivered us from our adversaries; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:25
segments: Who giveth food to all flesh; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:26
segments: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
